name: Naramata
sub: Bench-top wineries, lake views and slow, sunny days.

picks.name: Evolve Sparkling House

picks.copy: Outdoor seating that catches the sun setting over the lake.

plan.title: Getting around & parking
plan.copy: Wineries are spread along the Naramata Bench, so plan your route, book tastings where needed and arrange a designated driver or tour.
plan.label: Find Naramata wineries

plan.title: Wine tasting tips
plan.copy: Check hours, seasonal opening and whether reservations are needed before you go, and pace your tastings with food stops along the way.
plan.label: Find a bite to eat

plan.title: Visiting with kids or dogs
plan.copy: Many patios and wineries welcome kids and dogs. Check each listing for details and confirm current policies with the venue.
plan.label: Family-friendly places
